content.comment_body: I have an external [product_name] display, but there is no clear indication of which terminal is for positive and which is for negative connection.
12-24 V AC/DC For DC: P1 is positive (+), P2 is negative (-) For AC: P1 is Line (L), P2 is Neutral (N)

analysis.insight_summary: The user reported unclear documentation and labeling about the power connection polarity for an external [product_name] display, causing confusion about how to wire the terminals correctly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward documentation or clear labeling to identify plus and minus terminals for connecting power to the external display.
